forms: IDs 1–9: water/prepared aqueous forms. 10: finite CO2 gas. 18: calcite solid. 19: gypsum dihydrate solid. Batch outputs can be separated and aliquoted into empty vessels.
combinations: IDs 2-6: dilute monovalent strong-acid/base/salt mixtures and water. IDs 7-9: same reagent or water only.
runs: 81 stock/aliquot/dilution iterations (75 distinct stock conditions), dilute pH references, native integration, nine UI preparation/transfer/readout flows; 108 batch condition sets with repeat and aliquot checks; gypsum/Henry references and low-pressure gas law

batch.limitations: Separate independent final-equilibrium trials. One selected solid: Calcite or Gypsum. Closed ideal CO2 headspace or fixed external CO2. Extracted liquid only aliquots into empty vessels; no remix/dilution. Fixed 25 C, no kinetics, vapor, air or pressure correction.
